title: Windows verification baseline: rebuild the unchanged build as perf-builds\base2 instead of reusing perf-builds\base
context: Criterion 10.12 compares the fix against the unchanged build in the same session on the owner's PC. perf-builds\base was built 2026-10-12 23:17, before the perf checkout gave test builds their own notification identity (00:46) and stubbed reminder scheduling (00:49), so it schedules and cancels reminders under the owner's real AUMID and can hit the flutter_local_notifications_windows cancel abort. The fix build (perf-builds\fix, 12:25) was made by swapping the 7 Meadow files of ef95801d into C:\Users\satan\dev\field-notes-perf and restoring them afterwards.
options: Rebuild the unchanged build from the restored checkout as perf-builds\base2 (base 6b09587 + perf harness + reminder stub + own AUMID)
option_reasons: base2 differs from perf-builds\fix only in the 7 Meadow files, so the A/B isolates the fix, and it never touches the owner's reminders
It would differ from the fix build in reminder handling as well, and could schedule or cancel toasts under the owner's installed app identity
outcome: Built base2 at 12:3x on 2026-10-13. Verification runs via kit/win_verify.py (3 maximized cold opens with time changes and full-screen toggle per build, held-out windowed case per build, 2 fix and 1 base2 onboarding replays), results in ~/.mitosis/field-notes/meadow-perf/kit/results/win/verify.log and V-*.json, scored with kit/win_eval.py.
